critical_code_review_comments: pdf_report.py uses latin-1 with 'replace' fallback - non-latin1 unicode names (e.g. accented parent names) render as '?'. Consider fpdf2's Unicode TTF font (add_font) if internationalization is expected.

PDF endpoint at server.py:858 relies on caller-facing content-disposition filename derived from child_name; if child_name contains non-ASCII or quote chars, header may break. Consider sanitizing / using RFC 5987 filename* form.
